title: DualMiT-Net: Local-Global Transformer-Convolutional Fusion for Breast Mass Segmentation in Mammographic Regions of Interest
abstract: arXiv:2608.15019v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Breast mass segmentation is an important step in computer-aided mammography, but it remains difficult because masses can have low contrast, irregular shapes, and boundaries that blend with surrounding breast tissue. To address this problem, we present DualMiT-Net, a dual-branch network that uses both a focused view of the mass and a wider view of the surrounding tissue. The local branch uses a Mix Transformer (MiT-B5) encoder to learn mass shape, texture, and boundary information, while the global branch uses an EfficientNet-B5 encoder to learn surrounding breast context. Features from the two branches are shared at the deeper encoder levels and are then progressively fused in a single decoder. A spatial gate controls how much global information is added during decoding. We also evaluated four input representations and selected a percentile-windowed mammogram combined with a Gabor texture response. The model was trained and evaluated o

translated_title: DualMiT-Net：用于乳腺X线摄影感兴趣区域中乳腺肿块分割的局部-全局Transformer-卷积融合网络
translated_abstract: 乳腺肿块分割是计算机辅助乳腺X线摄影中的一个重要步骤，但由于肿块可能具有低对比度、不规则形状以及与周围乳腺组织融合的边界，这一任务仍然具有挑战性。为解决此问题，我们提出了DualMiT-Net，一种双分支网络，它同时利用肿块的聚焦视图和周围组织的宽视野。局部分支使用Mix Transformer（MiT-B5）编码器来学习肿块的形状、纹理和边界信息，而全局分支使用EfficientNet-B5编码器来学习周围乳腺背景。两个分支的特征在更深的编码器层级共享，并在单一解码器中逐步融合。一个空间门控控制解码过程中加入多少全局信息。我们还评估了四种输入表示，并选择了百分位窗口化的乳腺X线图像与Gabor纹理响应相结合的方法。该模型在...上进行训练和评估。
tldr: 本文提出了一种双分支网络（DualMiT-Net），通过局部Transformer编码器和全局卷积编码器的融合，并利用空间门控控制全局信息，有效解决了乳腺肿块分割中低对比度和边界模糊的难题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes DualMiT-Net, a dual-branch network fusing local Transformer and global convolutional encoders with a spatial gate to control global information, effectively addressing challenges in breast mass segmentation such as low contrast and blurred boundaries.
